emails.subject: Urgent: Q4 Project Deadline Update
emails.body:

We need to move the Q4 project deadline forward by one week to December 15th. Please review your tasks and let me know if this creates any conflicts.

- Testing and deployment by Dec 15th

Please confirm your availability for a quick sync meeting tomorrow at 10 AM.

Best regards,
Sarah Johnson
Project Manager
